paper.title_en: Quantum Induced 2D Gate Engineered Junctionless (GEJ) MOSFET for Highly Reliable 5G Communication Applications-Linearity and Distortion Analysis
paper.abstract_en: In this paper, Analog/radio frequency parameters are studied for Gate Engineered Junctionless (GEJ) with gate-oxide-stack. Additionally, the device induces quantum phenomena. This paper examines the major FOMs (Figures of Merit) for analog realization, including f$_{T}$ (cut-off frequency), GFP (gain-frequency product), TFP (transconductance-frequency-product), GFP (gain-frequency-product), g$_{d}$ (Output Conductance), V$_{EA}$ (early-voltage), g$_{m}$/I$_{D}$ (Trans-conductance-generation-factor), g$_{m}$ (trans-conductance), A$_{V}$ ( intrinsic-gain), and many more. The parameters of the device agree with the results of the study and simulation. An important part of the simulation study was the ATLAS device-simulator.
